device_io: none from ButtonProbe; the standing Runtime 005 dashboard ran unchanged under its own granted policy

method.probe: runtime/windows/OpenDitoo.ButtonProbe, commit fa9fd07, dll sha256 f758b922808874d84d531209b2d8f35556888fbdf0cb7f3c9fc117268fb75ae6, launched from WSL interop into the interactive session, --seconds 1800
method.telemetry: read-only sampler: 'openditoo status' + 'openditoo product-status' every ~0.7 s; Host session ledger (.openditoo-local/session-ledger.jsonl) for exact terminal times/reasons
method.clock: probe DateTime.UtcNow and Host ledger UTC are the same Windows machine clock
method.operator_script: quiet baseline, then Left, Right, Left, Lever; quiet; repeat. Operator reported shortened pauses (trial B spacing ~0.7 s)
method.operator_observation: nothing happened on the ditoo (no visible stock screen or page change during either trial)

A.host_effect: session 8bea1404a794 terminal canvas_invalidated at 16:40:32.5985820Z (inner report 0x09, 6.5 ms BEFORE the SMTC callback); product saw HTTP 409 -> transport_fault -> reconnect, new session 468610eb0b06 open 16:40:33.629Z (~1.0 s)

B.host_effect: session 468610eb0b06 terminal canvas_invalidated at 16:41:12.1534262Z (inner report 0xBD, 4 payload bytes); product reclaim (reclaims=1), session fd3128a7b84e open 16:41:12.183Z (30 ms)

findings.statement: 6/6 arrow presses produced exactly one SMTC event each, correctly mapped (Left->Previous, Right->Next), in both trials, including at ~0.7 s spacing. No duplicate, no extra normalized event.

No WM_APPCOMMAND and no raw-input keyboard/consumer record accompanied any Ditoo press: Windows routes the Ditoo's AVRCP straight into SMTC, not as injected media keys. The two rawinput_consumer records (16:29:55, 16:37:03) came from an unrelated Logitech receiver (VID_046D PID_C539) outside the trials.

findings.confidence: MATCHED (2 of 2 exact-unit contexts: M7 and BTN-2)
findings.statement: The first Left of trial A was accompanied by an unsolicited RFCOMM 0x09 report that the Runtime 005 Host treated as canvas_invalidated, exactly like the first Left in M7 (0x09 2.7 ms before AVRCP). 1 of 6 arrow presses here; the other 5 were session-neutral. The dashboard recovered in ~1 s via reconnect and the operator saw no change.
findings.consequence: Pagination must survive a Host session ending on an arrow press: page state lives in the router, and a fresh session resumes the selected page. The canvas_invalidated fence is NOT weakened.

findings.statement: Trial A lever: SMTC Pause, no 0xBD. Trial B lever: 0xBD (Host yield + reclaim), no SMTC event. Neither pull produced both; M7's single pull produced both.
findings.consequence: Lever stays out of pagination; BTN-7 characterization needed before any lever semantics.

findings.statement: No stock screen or visible change during either trial, including across the one 0x09 session end and the 0xBD reclaim.
